# Kendo Icons

This repository contains the source SVG icons and the SVG and font icon packages.

## Source and packages

- `src/telerik-icons/` contains the source SVG variants and shared icon metadata.
- `packages/svg-icons/` and `packages/font-icons/` contain the published packages.
- Use the `manage-icons` skill for changes to icons, metadata, or aliases.

## Validation

- Run `npm run build` when changing shared icon sources or metadata; it builds both packages.
- Run `npm run eslint` when changing JavaScript scripts.
